[Dīghāyuka+kamma]  CL=8 Meritorious deeds that lead to longevity, good kamma that promotes long life. This kamma refers to the wholesome action of abstaining from taking the lives of others. It includes observing moral precepts, maintaining the five precepts, performing acts of generosity, engaging in healing practices, and consistently showing respect and reverence to those who are senior in age, monastic status, virtue, or experience.
Among these, the wholesome kamma of abstaining from taking life, while it may not directly result in rebirth in celestial realms, supports longevity in the following ways for those born in the human realm due to other kamma:
